desc.zh:text: 靠数据、算力、算法跑起来的新一代通用技术
desc.en:text: A general-purpose technology built on data, compute and algorithms

desc.zh:text: 技术有大突破、要素配得更合理，才会长出来的新生产力形态
desc.en:text: A new form of productivity that appears only when technology breaks through and factors are allocated better

desc.zh:text: 可复制、可复用、越用越增值的第五大生产要素
desc.en:text: The fifth production factor: copyable, reusable and value-adding

desc.zh:text: 智能算力规模快速扩张，成为新质生产力的「基础能源」
desc.en:text: Rapidly expanding smart compute acts as the energy of NQPF

desc.zh:text: 大模型把知识封装成可以调用的通用能力
desc.en:text: Large models package knowledge into callable general capability

desc.zh:text: 训练与推理的燃料，也是产业知识的载体
desc.en:text: Fuel for training and inference, and a carrier of industrial know-how

desc.zh:text: 从单一技能走向人机协同的高技能劳动者
desc.en:text: From single-skilled workers to human-AI collaboration

desc.zh:text: 生产工具从机械装备升级为「算法 + 算力」
desc.en:text: Tools evolve from machinery to algorithms plus compute

desc.zh:text: 数据、知识与场景成为新的加工对象
desc.en:text: Data, knowledge and scenarios become new objects of labour

desc.zh:text: 同样的投入能产出更多——看新质生产力主要就看它
desc.en:text: More output from the same input: the main measure of NQPF

desc.zh:text: 智能驾驶、具身智能、生成式内容等全新赛道
desc.en:text: New tracks such as autonomous driving, embodied AI and generative content

desc.zh:text: 用算法把能耗和排放压下来，同样的产出少花代价
desc.en:text: Algorithms push energy use and emissions down, so each unit of output costs less

desc.zh:text: 重复岗位被替代，同时催生大量新职业
desc.en:text: Repetitive roles decline while many new occupations emerge

desc.zh:text: 国家级行动：把 AI 装进各行各业
desc.en:text: A national initiative: put AI into every industry

desc.zh:text: 让数据在更多场景里流动、反复用、越用越值钱
desc.en:text: Let data flow, be reused and gain value in more settings

desc.zh:text: 机器视觉质检、预测性维护、柔性排产
desc.en:text: Vision inspection, predictive maintenance, flexible scheduling

desc.zh:text: 影像辅助诊断、AI 制药、基层远程诊疗
desc.en:text: Imaging diagnosis, AI drug discovery, remote care

desc.zh:text: 遥感巡田、无人机植保、智能育种
desc.en:text: Remote sensing, drone spraying, smart breeding

desc.zh:text: 个性化学习路径与普惠优质资源
desc.en:text: Personalized learning paths and inclusive resources

desc.zh:text: 电网调度、风光功率预测、能耗优化
desc.en:text: Grid dispatch, renewable forecasting, energy optimization

desc.zh:text: 交通治理、公共安全与政务服务的智能升级
desc.en:text: Traffic, public safety and government services
